title: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Task Learning for Joint Modulation Recognition and SINR Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.28865v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint modulation recognition and signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) estimation can reduce duplicated processing in intelligent receivers, but the two tasks have different uncertainty characteristics. This letter proposes an uncertainty-aware multi-task model that transforms each short normalized in-phase/quadrature window into 36 deterministic, label-free statistics, learns a shared representation, and uses task-specific adapters for modulation classification and heteroscedastic SINR regression. A joint uncertainty score combines classification entropy and predicted regression variance to support selective inference. Simulations cover QPSK, 8PSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM under matched additive white Gaussian noise/Rayleigh channels and an unseen frequency-selective Rician channel. Over five independent seeds, the proposed model improves matched and unseen-channel accuracy over conventional multi-task learning by 14.86 and 8.61 perc

translated_title: 面向调制识别与SINR估计联合任务的不确定性感知多任务学习
translated_abstract: 调制识别与信号干扰加噪声比（SINR）估计的联合处理可以减少智能接收机中的重复处理，但这两个任务具有不同的不确定性特性。本信提出了一种不确定性感知的多任务模型，该模型将每个短归一化同相/正交（I/Q）窗口转换为36个确定性的、无标签的统计量，学习共享表示，并使用任务特定的适配器进行调制分类和异方差SINR回归。联合不确定性分数结合了分类熵和预测的回归方差，以支持选择性推断。仿真涵盖了匹配的加性白高斯噪声/瑞利信道以及未见过的频率选择性莱斯信道下的QPSK、8PSK、16QAM和64QAM。在五个独立随机种子上，所提出的模型在匹配信道和未见信道上的准确率比传统多任务学习分别提高了14.86和8.61个百分点。
tldr: 提出了一种不确定性感知的多任务学习模型，通过将I/Q信号窗口转换为无标签统计量并结合任务特定适配器，联合实现调制识别与SINR估计，在匹配和未见信道上准确率分别提升14.86和8.61个百分点。
en_tdlr: An uncertainty-aware multi-task model that converts I/Q signal windows into label-free statistics with task-specific adapters for joint modulation recognition and SINR estimation, improving accuracy by 14.86 and 8.61 percentage points on matched and unseen channels respectively.
